game_title: Type Cast Forge – Smoke Ridge Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: In Smoke Ridge, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the magma valve using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The magma valve reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the magma valve is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The magma valve reached with actions_used <= 10.
